string.text: Find the Advanced Toolkit
With this toolkit, Uncle Yar will have tools detailed enough to do better upgrades for weapons and armor.
Find the Expert Toolkit
With this toolkit, Uncle Yar will have enough tools to do virtually any upgrades for weapons and armor.
Find the Flash Drive: SVU
With this Flash Drive, Uncle Yar will have information on how to modify a SVU sniper rifle.
Find the Flash Drive: Tactical RP-74
With this Flash Drive, Uncle Yar will have information on how to modify a light machine gun.
Find the Flash Drive: SEVA
With this Flash Drive, Uncle Yar will have information on how to modify a closed circuit environmental protection suit.
Find the Flash Drive: Electronic Stablization
With this Flash Drive, Uncle Yar will have information on how to add electronic stablization systems to weapons.
Find the Flash Drive: Exoskeleton Servomotors
With this Flash Drive, Uncle Yar will have information on how to modify servomotors on an Exoskeleton.
Deliver weapon
The Freedom squad is in need of a replacement assult rifle for a squad member
Deliver ammo
The Freedom squad has requested ammo for their rifles
Deliver mediacal supplies
The Freedom squad needs some more medical supplies
Deliver grenades
The Freedom squad is low on grenades and is requesting more
Deliver a Boar's hoof
Checkov is making Boar Stew for the other Freedom commanders, and needs the hoof of a Boar to complete it. Shouldn't be too hard to find one.
Deliver a Flesh eye
One of the Freedom techs is researching eye lens of the Flesh for Sniper rifles. Creepy.
Deliver a Snork's leg
One of the Freedom techs needs a snork leg for something. Judging by what Checkov said, the guy sounds crazy. Wait till Duty hears of this.
Deliver a Pellicle artifact
Freedom wants a Pelicile artifact to study, after seeing a Loner with one.
Deliver a Crystal Thorn artifact
Freedom scientists want to figure out what makes the Crystal Thorn different to the regular Thorn, and want one to study.
Deliver a GP37 rifle
Freedom scouts have observed the Bandits with a new assault rifle, and want one to test its capabilities.
Deliver a FT-200M rifle
Freedom have heard that the Merc's have some new fancy high tech assault rifle, and want one as proof. Shouldn't be to hard to swipe one now should it?
